name: Felix Simulator
source:
Do you ever have this weird situation were your not-by-blood brother wants you to buy chocolate because his back hurts? No? Well this game has it!

Of course it won't be so easy, and ends going anywhere but the store, but those are just details...

An angsty short game for spending a little time as someone else.

[From[url=https://guroyoru.itch.io/felix-simulator] Itch.io[/url]]
